extends SceneTree
class Port extends RefCounted:
	var requests: Array = []
	var answers: Array = [false, true]
	var callback: Callable
	var unsubscriptions := 0
	func request_scene(target: String) -> bool:
		requests.append(target)
		return answers.pop_front() if not answers.is_empty() else true
	func subscribe_event(_event: String, value: Callable) -> int:
		callback = value
		return 1
	func unsubscribe_event(_token: int) -> bool:
		unsubscriptions += 1
		return true
func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("check")
func event(pressed: bool):
	var value := InputEventAction.new()
	value.action = "navigation_test"
	value.pressed = pressed
	return value
func edge(node, pressed: bool, handled: bool = false) -> void:
	if pressed:
		Input.action_press("navigation_test")
	else:
		Input.action_release("navigation_test")
	var value = event(pressed)
	node._input(value)
	if not handled:
		node._unhandled_input(value)
func check() -> void:
	InputMap.add_action("navigation_test")
	Input.action_press("navigation_test")
	var port := Port.new()
	var action = preload("res://action.gd").new()
	action.action_name = "navigation_test"
	action.target_scene_id = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
	action.set_meta("viento_project", port)
	root.add_child(action)
	action._on_focus_entered()
	action._process(0)
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 0, "initial held action fired")
	edge(action, false)
	edge(action, true, true)
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 0, "GUI-consumed edge or second mapped press fired")
	var echo := InputEventKey.new()
	echo.pressed = true
	echo.echo = true
	action._input(echo)
	action._unhandled_input(echo)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 0, "echo fired")
	edge(action, false)
	Input.action_press("navigation_test")
	var pending = event(true)
	action._input(pending)
	action._on_focus_exited()
	action._on_focus_entered()
	action._unhandled_input(pending)
	action._process(0)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 0, "focus replayed a pending held edge")
	edge(action, false)
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 1 and not action._accepted, "normal refusal was not preserved")
	for step in range(10):
		action._process(0.016)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 1, "idle retried a refused request")
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 1, "held action retried a refused request")
	edge(action, false)
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 2 and action._accepted, "fresh edge did not retry once")
	edge(action, false)
	edge(action, true)
	assert(port.requests.size() == 2, "accepted visit repeated")
	action.free()
	Input.action_release("navigation_test")
	var event_port := Port.new()
	var listener = preload("res://event.gd").new()
	listener.target_scene_id = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
	listener.payload_filter = "win"
	listener.set_meta("viento_project", event_port)
	root.add_child(listener)
	assert(event_port.callback.call(false) == true)
	assert(event_port.callback.call("lose") == true)
	assert(event_port.requests.size() == 0, "filter accepted wrong scalar")
	assert(event_port.callback.call("win") == true)
	assert(event_port.requests.size() == 1 and not listener._accepted, "refusal caused callback failure")
	await process_frame
	assert(event_port.requests.size() == 1, "event listener retried without a new event")
	assert(event_port.callback.call("win") == true)
	assert(event_port.callback.call("win") == true)
	assert(event_port.requests.size() == 2 and listener._accepted, "duplicate event navigation was not ignored")
	listener.free()
	assert(event_port.unsubscriptions == 1, "event subscription retained after exit")
	print("NAVIGATION_CONTRACT:" + JSON.stringify({"actionAttempts":port.requests.size(),"eventAttempts":event_port.requests.size(),"unsubscriptions":event_port.unsubscriptions,"scope":"Controlled InputEventAction/focus callbacks and fake visit-port contracts; not XTest"}))
	quit()
